title: Meet Esther, the Heart Behind House of Jaby
intro: House of Jaby began on 2 February 2026 with something simple: a love for creating food and the desire to build something of my own.

My first clients invited me into their homes, where I prepared meals and snacks for them in their own kitchens. It was a humble beginning, but it gave me the opportunity to serve people personally, develop my craft, and begin building the House of Jaby name one order at a time.
I still prepare food in clients’ homes today.

I believe in quality over quantity. For me, that means carefully measured recipes, balanced flavours, thoughtful preparation, and attention to detail at every stage. I want everything I create to reflect the care that goes into making it.
Because food is more than what is placed on a plate. It is the care, intention, and craft behind it.

moment.title: A Moment That Made It Real
body: One of the moments I treasure most was being invited to cater an event.
I was given the opportunity to prepare food for the guests. After enjoying the food, one of the guests wanted to meet the person behind House of Jaby.
The event owner introduced me to them, and that moment meant more than I can easily put into words.
Knowing that the food I had created had made such an impression that a guest wanted to meet the person behind it was deeply encouraging.
It gave House of Jaby its first real opportunity to be seen beyond the kitchen.
Since then, the kind feedback and encouragement I have received from the people I serve have continued to inspire me and strengthen my belief in what House of Jaby can become.

jabyWay.title: Crafted Moments, The Jaby Way
body: At House of Jaby, we believe that the details matter.
From carefully measured recipes and balanced flavours to thoughtful preparation and beautiful presentation, every part of what we create is approached with care.

Whether it is a cake marking a special birthday, pastries and snacks shared with loved ones, catering for an event, or a meal prepared in your own home, our goal is to create something that feels worthy of the moment.
When you choose House of Jaby, I want you to feel confident in what you have ordered and cared for throughout the experience.
Because the moments we help create become part of your memories.
jabyWay.pullQuote: I want the memories we help you create to feel truly special to you.

highlights.title: Carefully Measured Recipes
highlights.desc: Every recipe is approached with precision and consistency.

highlights.title: Balanced Flavours
highlights.desc: Thoughtfully prepared flavours that make every bite worth remembering.

highlights.title: Personal Attention
highlights.desc: A personal touch in every order, whether it is prepared for your celebration or right in your own home.

closing.title: Let’s Create Something Special
body: From intimate moments at home to celebrations shared with many, House of Jaby is here to make your moments memorable.

Whether you're looking for a beautifully crafted cake, delicious pastries and snacks, catering for your event, a meal prepared in your home, or something special created just for your occasion, we'd love to bring it to life, the Jaby way.
Based in Nairobi and serving beyond, we'll work with you to understand what you need and arrange the details with you directly.
